title: Export to NWB
description: Writes the recording, its ROIs and their signals to an NWB file, as dev's NWBExporter wrote the stack: a TwoPhotonSeries in acquisition (written a chunk at a time, data as frames x columns x rows), the ROIs as a PlaneSegmentation of pixel masks with their ids and classification, and the signals as RoiResponseSeries in Fluorescence and DfOverF, linked to their ROIs. A variable left empty, or with no file, is left out. Needs pynwb in Python and matnwb in MATLAB.

path.title: File
path.description: Where the NWB file is written; relative to the project's folder unless absolute.

firstFrame.title: First frame
firstFrame.description: The first frame to process, from 1 (dev's frame interval): the method works on frames firstFrame..lastFrame only, and its outputs have that many frames.

lastFrame.title: Last frame
lastFrame.description: The last frame to process; 0 for the last frame of the stack.
